basic_details.job_title: DIC Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.job_location: New Delhi (transferable to project locations of IndiaAI as per policy)

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified to shortlisted candidates

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of the applications. Specific numerical age limits are not mentioned in the official notification.

qualification.details: 4+ years of experience in operations management and administration in a large setup, preferable Govt. set up. Knowledge of GFR, GEM and other Government process for procurement, bidding, administration aspects. Strong organizational and project management skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Knowledge of procurement and vendor management. Knowledge of human resources management. Experience with administration operation.

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/.
Ensure you meet the required eligibility criteria before filling out the online application.
Complete the online registration and fill out the application form with all required details.
Upload necessary documents and certificates as required by the portal.
Submit the application online on or before 21.10.2026.

Candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central / State Government, Public Sector Undertakings, or Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or attach/produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC).
important_instructions: The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of India AI. Appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at India AI or on any future vacancies. Screening of applications is based on qualifications and relevant experience; IndiaAI reserves the right to fix higher thresholds to limit candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews. IndiaAI reserves the right to terminate the appointments with a notice of one month or without notice by paying one month's salary in lieu thereof. Queries may be directed to the HR Division at [email protected] or at 4th Floor, Electronics Niketan 6-CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003.
